outcome: Newborn's first outpatient visit (FOV) beyond 3 days after postpartum hospital discharge
cohort: Newborns born at a large urban university hospital during a 1-year period, discharged home within 96 hours of birth, and with an outpatient visit with an affiliated provider within 60 days after discharge
finding: Several newborn, maternal, provider, and practice characteristics were independently associated with the timing of the newborn's first outpatient visit after hospital discharge.
mod_finding: Newborns born via Caesarian section were more likely to have their first outpatient visit beyond 3 days after discharge.
